0x0020FC.en: 「Hehe... With such words... you'd see me off...」

0x002824.en: 「Sure. Ra-Gias aside,@ that guy never once did anything@ to put us at a disadvantage back on Earth.」

0x0028C3.en: 「Yeah... that's true.@　If anything, he helped us out.」

0x00291F.en: 「Besides, we just had a fight like that...@　Honestly, I'm beat...」

0x0029A7.en: 「XO, keep close watch on the Cross Gate@　and order all units back to the ship.」

0x002A03.en: 「Understood.@　Let's just pray nothing happens now.」

0x002A5C.en: 「If that thing brings disaster again...@　it won't be Baral or the Gaia Sabers - it'll be us...」

0x002AE5.en: 「...If we're allowed, let us once more@　be the sword that guards the Earth.」

0x002B66.en: 「Besides, I... I can't believe the Cross Gate@　brings only misfortune...」

0x002BDA.en: 「After all, thanks to it, we may have been able@　to return to our own world...」

0x002C5E.en: 「...You've truly done well.@　Thanks to you all, the Earth sphere has been saved.」

0x002CF4.en: 「With Alteur Steinbeck's true identity exposed,@　there's an uproar everywhere.」

0x002D62.en: 「After all, an alien... the very one who sent the@　<Meteor 3> held a top post in the Federation.」

0x002DF3.en: 「The current administration is sure to collapse...@　Everyone who was deeply involved with the Gaia Sabers@　and survived is under arrest.」

0x002E80.en: 「I see...@　And what of our own fate?」

0x002FE3.en: 「It won't take long for your names@　to be cleared.」

0x00330D.en: 「It was...@　but the fighting we've been through changed that view.」
